title: botai learning session
description: One sitting with one course, and the state it is in. The session pins the course revision so a course that changes mid-sitting cannot change the rules the sitting is being taught under; and it records the assessment in force so help is capped by what the course declares rather than by what the conversation drifted into.

contract_hash.description: The accepted contract this session runs under. A session is never silently re-pointed at a newer revision.

session_minutes.description: How long the learner agreed to work. A real limit, not a hint: the session offers to stop rather than pushing past it.

objective_ids.description: The agreed plan for this sitting. A session works on one objective at a time; this is the shortlist it may draw from.

consent_version.description: null means no recorded consent: the session stays in CONSENT_PENDING and does not teach.

resume_state.description: Where a paused or blocked session returns to. null outside PAUSED/BLOCKED.

assistance_max.description: Highest level reached in this session's cycle. null means no attempt has happened yet — which is a different statement from NONE ("an attempt was made with no help"), and the two must not be conflated.

independence_claim.description: What the learner says about how they worked. A self-report, never treated as proof of independent work.

steps_taken.description: Teaching steps completed in this sitting. A budget on how long one session may run: rule 5 of the policy asks the agent to respect capacity, and this is the mechanism behind that sentence. Counting steps rather than tokens keeps the limit independent of which model is answering.

action.description: `offer_break` and `close_or_pause` are the capacity actions: one warns before the budget, the other stops new material at it.
